faq.a1: Naajah connects university students with experienced specialists in programming, AI, data science, databases, research support, graduation projects, reports and tutoring.
faq.q2: How do I order a service?
faq.a2: Open the service, choose a package and tap “Contact us on WhatsApp”. We will reply to agree on the details, price and delivery date. No payment is made through the website.
faq.a3: Yes. Services focus on learning, guidance, review and support for your own work. We do not offer exam-taking or impersonation services and remove listings that do.
faq.q5: How do I become a provider?
faq.a5: Register as a provider, complete your profile and submit it for verification. Our team reviews every application.
